questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Find courses in the web system. Apply for a combination of courses. A little difficult to find exactly 30 points worth, but it worked out fine.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: guides, international desk, helpful people at the departmental and the school (social science) level

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Got precisely what I hoped for!

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I just applied for a bunch and I got into the two courses I actually wanted

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Both masters level intro courses, so not to easy but still manageable. Got time to socialize :)

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Three exams per course, and two courses per semester --> six exams in total !!! An exam every three weeks. That was a lot...

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: "Introduction to Sociology of Law" and "GIS: Geographical Information System for the Social Sciences"

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Both of mine were good. Enjoyed the hands on of the GIS course

questions.answer: Nothing, i guess. Danes and Swedes a lot alike

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Lund is a good food town, beautiful architecture, easy to travel with train (incl. Øresundstoget)

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Try to learn some Swedish
Don't hesitate speaking Danish
Remember to get north to other cities/towns
